description: Single retiree age 72 with a large pension and Social Security: benefits taxable at the 85% cap and the senior deduction fully phased out.
worked:
Line numbers are those of the 2025 Form 1040, its instructions' worksheets and Schedule 1-A; the figures are the 2026 ones from the federal file.
Filing status: single.
Taxpayer: born 1954-04-04, age 72 at the end of 2026.
Form 1040: lines 4b + 5b taxable pensions and IRA distributions 150,000; line 6a Social Security benefits 40,000.
Social Security Benefits Worksheet (Form 1040 instructions, lines 6a and 6b; Publication 915 Worksheet 1):
  line 1 = 40,000; line 2 = 50% x 40,000 = 20,000
  line 3 (lines 1z, 2b, 3b, 4b, 5b, 7a, 8) = 150,000; line 4 (line 2a) = 0
  line 5 = 20,000 + 150,000 + 0 = 170,000; line 6 (Schedule 1 adjustments) = 0; line 7 = 170,000
  line 8 (base amount, single) = 25,000
  line 9 = 170,000 - 25,000 = 145,000; line 10 = 9,000 (34,000 adjusted base amount - 25,000); line 11 = 136,000
  line 12 = smaller of 145,000 and 9,000 = 9,000; line 13 = 4,500; line 14 = smaller of 20,000 and 4,500 = 4,500
  line 15 = 85% x 136,000 = 115,600; line 16 = 4,500 + 115,600 = 120,100
  line 17 = 85% x 40,000 = 34,000; line 18 = smaller of 120,100 and 34,000 = 34,000 -> Form 1040 line 6b
Form 1040 line 9 total income = 150,000 + 34,000 = 184,000; line 10 adjustments 0; line 11a/11b adjusted gross income = 184,000.
Line 12e standard deduction = 16,100 basic (single) + 1 x 2,050 additional (unmarried amount, one per box checked on line 12d for age 65 or older / blind) = 18,150.
Schedule 1-A: line 1 = line 11b 184,000; line 3 MAGI = 184,000 (no excluded income).
  Part V: line 31 = 184,000; line 32 = 75,000; line 33 = 109,000; line 34 = 6% x 109,000 = 6,540; line 35 = 6,000 - 6,540, zero or less, so 0
  line 36a (born before January 2, 1962) = 0; line 37 = 0 -> line 38 -> Form 1040 line 13b
Line 14 = 18,150 + 0 = 18,150; line 15 taxable income = 184,000 - 18,150 = 165,850.
Form 1040 line 16 (regular tax): Tax Rate Schedule X (single) on 165,850: 10% x 12,400 = 1,240; 12% x (50,400 - 12,400) = 4,560; 22% x (105,700 - 50,400) = 12,166; 24% x (165,850 - 105,700) = 14,436; total 32,402
Form 8960: lines 8 and 12 net investment income = 0; line 13 MAGI = 184,000; line 14 threshold = 200,000; line 15 = 184,000 - 200,000, zero or less, so 0; line 17 net investment income tax = 0.
Form 8959: no wages or self-employment income; additional Medicare tax 0.
Total tax = 32,402 regular + 0 net investment income tax + 0 additional Medicare tax = 32,402.
